Junior Software Developer
Hauppauge, NY
Full Time
Entry Level
 SHARE
ASR International Corp is seeking a Junior Software Developer to join the ASR IT Systems Team at our Corporate Headquarters in Hauppauge, NY. This full-time, on-site, entry-level position offers an outstanding opportunity for a motivated individual to develop technical and professional skills while contributing to the design, development, and enhancement of business systems that support company operations and programs of national importance. The selected candidate will have opportunities to gain experience with enterprise application development, business process automation, cloud technologies, cybersecurity, AI-powered solutions, and broader IT operations in support of critical business operations across the full software development lifecycle. This is not a remote position and only local candidates will be considered.

Responsibilities
Participate in the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of internal business systems, software applications, web applications, websites, integrations, and business process automation solutions, including Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) initiatives.
Work with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate business needs into effective technical solutions that improve business operations and efficiency.
Develop and maintain APIs, database queries, reports, and system integrations.
Participate in software testing, code reviews, and quality assurance activities to ensure reliable and maintainable solutions.
Apply secure coding and cybersecurity best practices throughout the software development lifecycle.
Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve software, application, and data-related issues.
Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, user guides, and training materials for technical and non-technical audiences.
Research and evaluate new technologies, tools, and techniques to support continuous improvement and innovation.
Provide technical support and assistance related to internally developed applications, business systems, and other IT initiatives as needed.
Perform other related duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to continuously learn and improve in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Familiarity with software development practices and modern computing environments, including Git-based version control, SQL databases, APIs, Linux, cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWS, virtualization, containerization, and secure coding principles.
Knowledge of programming, scripting, automation, and software development concepts, including experience with at least one programming or scripting language.
Hands-on experience with full-stack (front-end and back-end) modern web application and API development using technologies such as PHP, Python, JavaScript, and HTML/CSS.
Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies independently and apply them to solve business problems.
Must be a United States citizen, with the ability to pass a background investigation and obtain a security clearance as required.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with JavaScript frameworks / libraries such as React.js, Node.js, and Next.js is a plus.
Experience / familiarity with business process automation and scripting for Microsoft 365, including Power Automate, SharePoint site design and development, and PowerShell / Python scripting using the Microsoft Graph API is a plus.
Experience with prompt engineering and integration of Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools into business processes.
 
ASR offers a comprehensive benefits package which includes Holidays, Paid Time Off and Sick Days, Health Insurance (medical, dental and vision); and a 401(k) plan.
 

About ASR International

ASR provides world-wide Management and Technical Support Services to Government agencies and Fortune 500 customers. Founded in 1986 and headquartered in Long Island, NY, ASR serves its clients with a full spectrum of complex professional and technical support services including Construction Management, Engineering, Logistics, Project Management and Quality Control across the U.S. and in more than 40 countries worldwide.

Benefits

Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, an excellent compensation package and comprehensive benefits package which include a flexible work schedule, Paid Holidays, Paid Time Off and Sick Days, Health Insurance (medical, dental and vision); and a 401(k) plan.

The salary range provided for this role is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. ASR considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by people assigned to this job description. The job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required for this position. Please note that your resume and candidacy may be subject to customer approval, acceptance and clearing of the required background check and successfully obtaining and maintaining any required security clearances, if any.

ASR is committed to the policy of equal employment opportunity. In order to provide equal employment and advancement opportunities to all individuals, employment and promotion decisions at ASR are based on merit, qualifications, and abilities. ASR’s hiring and employment practices are not influenced or affected by an applicant’s or employee’s race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, veteran status, marital status, ancestry, ethnicity, physical or mental handicap / disability which is unrelated to job performance, sexual orientation or any other characteristic / classification protected by law.
